tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search DesAira for videos, hashtags, and creators by keyword.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Fetch metadata for one DesAira video by hash. Returns page_url to link to (no direct media URL).

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Get a sample of the newest public DesAira videos (max 20).

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Get trending DesAira videos by engagement for a time window (max 20).

tools.name: list_creators
tools.description: Browse the public DesAira creator directory by follower count (max 20).

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List the most popular DesAira hashtag categories by video count (max 20).

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Fetch a DesAira creator's public profile plus their newest videos.
